notes: ACCESS: plain requests + desktop Chrome UA reached every page directly (same route the prior Home-Decor pass used); no Cloudflare/WAF challenge, and robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot rule. TREE: Oliver Bonas keeps furniture in a separate top-level /furniture department, NOT under /homeware (the assigned site_url). The tree was taken from the site's own Furniture mega-menu markup in the SSR HTML of https://www.oliverbonas.com/furniture (4 groups: Seating, Tables, Storage Furniture, Drinks Trolleys, plus a 'Room' column), then reconciled against every /furniture/* entry in https://www.oliverbonas.com/sitemap.xml, which surfaced three real nodes absent from the mega-menu: Tub Chairs, Boucle Chairs and Storage Furniture > Lockers. JSON-LD BreadcrumbList on each page confirmed true parentage (e.g. Furniture | Tables | Bedside Tables; Furniture | Armchairs & Chairs | Accent Chairs). QTY: primary evidence is the site's own rendered filters button, literally 'See all N items' ('See N item(s)' at 0/1) - the same live result counter the prior Home-Decor pass used. Every leaf was fetched twice in separate reads and the figure was identical both times, and on all 22 pages that render it the number matched, exactly, the count of <product-listing-wishlist> product tiles in the same SSR grid (the grid is fully server-rendered, no pagination). Two pages (Cabinets & Sideboards, Garden Furniture) render the button as 'See all items' with no number in SSR, so they were counted by full tile enumeration using that 22/22-validated method; Cabinets was independently confirmed as 7 products by a WebFetch render, and Garden Furniture's 3 tiles were read out individually. Counts differ per category (0..95) so no site-wide constant is being echoed. CEILING CHECK: the SSR grid caps at 100 tiles (proved on /homeware/by-room/home-office, which reports 293 but renders 100) - every furniture page here is at or below 97 tiles, so none is truncated. HIERARCHY: per rule 2, Seating (own page 49), Armchairs & Chairs (40), Tables (26) and Storage Furniture (52) all have extractable children and were therefore emitted as grouping rows, not leaves; this deliberately leaves some of their population uncounted (e.g. Armchairs & Chairs 40 vs Accent Chairs 31). EXCLUDED: /furniture/all, /furniture/category/all and /furniture/new (Shop All / New In); /sale/category/furniture (Sale); /furniture/pre-order (empty landing page); /furniture/fabric/* (fabric swatches - furniture parts, and product pages); /furniture/collection/{rattan-furniture,velvet,wood-furniture} and /furniture/inlay-furniture and /furniture/armchairs-chairs/boucle-chairs (all material cuts - rule 3 bars material filter/collection pages; note boucle-chairs does self-canonicalise so it is a real page, 9 items, if the merge ever wants it); /furniture/armchairs-chairs/{blue,green,orange,pink,white} (colour facets - they canonicalise back to the parent, so not real categories); /furniture/category/chairs-stools (301-equivalent, canonicalises to /furniture/armchairs-chairs). NOT FURNITURE: the whole /homeware tree was walked - its mega-menu has no furniture node at all (Home Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Home Fragrance, Home Furnishings=textiles), /homeware/category/storage (70) is baskets/boxes/organisers = the future Storage task, /homeware/category/{seagrass-baskets,storage-baskets,hooks,wine-racks,bookends} are standalone storage/decor goods, and the six /homeware/by-room/* hubs render as 'Living Room Accessories', 'Hallway Decor', 'Bathroom Accessories' etc. - decor aggregates, not furniture. OVERLAP: the six 'Shop by Room' rows are the site's own furniture-department room cuts and overlap the product-type rows by design; they are separate real URLs with their own counts, so they are kept (same treatment the prior Home-Decor pass gave this site's room-based Lighting nodes). Oliver Bonas sells no sofas, beds, wardrobes-as-a-category or dining tables as separate nodes - the Seating facet list is only Armchairs(19)/Bar Stools(3)/Chairs(14)/Ottomans(13)/Rocking Chairs(1).
